response.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff is interpreted as inclusive (≥ 10323804), not exclusive, treating tracks at or above this byte size as 'large'

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff could be interpreted as exclusive (> 10323804), including only tracks strictly larger than the threshold
